* One job type that can fail silently is the cron job for registry updates in crons/registry.py, which is managed by crons/manager.py.
* The consequence is that if this job fails, the system may not be aware of the latest updates, leading to potential security vulnerabilities or outdated capabilities.
* A suggested fix is to implement retry mechanisms and notification systems for failed cron jobs, ensuring that failures are properly logged and alerted to the system administrators through core/logger.py and core/observability.py.
